original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹伦拜克发生致命族群冲突后 UNMISS加强平民保护与和平努力
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据南苏丹湖泊州当局称，10月8日至9日伦拜克发生族群间冲突，造成60人死亡、78人受伤，约500个家庭暂时流离失所。联合国南苏丹特派团（UNMISS）部署快速反应部队保护平民和关键设施，并撤离了17名被困的人道主义工作者。目前当地局势已恢复平静，当局称已部署安全部队并与社区领袖接触以防暴力重演。

key_facts.fact: 据湖泊州当局称，10月8日至9日伦拜克族群间冲突造成60人死亡、78人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: According to State authorities, intercommunal fighting in Rumbek on 8 and 9 October left 60 people dead and 78 wounded

key_facts.fact: 约500个家庭因冲突暂时流离失所，商铺也遭到袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: about 500 families were temporarily displaced. Businesses were also targeted as violence swept through the town

key_facts.fact: UNMISS尼泊尔维和部队部署快速反应部队保护平民和关键设施
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: peacekeepers from Nepal serving with the United Nations Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS) swiftly deployed a Quick Reaction Force to help protect civilians and safeguard critical facilities

key_facts.fact: UNMISS次日派车队前往伦拜克以北的Amok Payam，撤离17名被困的人道主义工作者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: UNMISS dispatched a convoy to Amok Payam, north of Rumbek, to extract 17 humanitarian workers who were trapped there

key_facts.fact: 湖泊州代理州长称已部署安全部队并与社区领袖接触，防止暴力重演
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Lakes State caretaker Governor, Rin Tueny Mabor, said security forces had been deployed and that he was engaging community leaders to prevent a recurrence of the violence

uncertainties: 伤亡与流离失所人数为州当局单方面说法，尚未获得独立核实
事件目前仅有一个来源（UNMISS）报道，缺乏交叉验证
